rationale: The third student. One teacher (cuadrilla, the gauntlet-best at +12.04), trained on the FULL pooled two-machine corpus (22,640 datasets / 56k matches; 3M samples drawn from 358 matches across 130 runs, reserved gauntlet arenas/seeds excluded by assertion). Two upgrades over DISCIPLE: features v2 (47 floats — per-enemy reload/ammo/weapon, own weapon, nearest incoming bullet threat via the dodge-organ scan, one tick of memory) and HIT-FILTERED AIM: the 24-bin head trained only on the 6.6% of rows whose shot landed within the 40-tick flight window — the teacher's precision without its whiffs. Hard lesson paid for en route: the first net anchored its aim on the previous-aim history feature (the teacher's prev-aim is always near-target in the tape, so the student's own drift self-confirmed — 26.6° live aim error vs 7.9° ablated, and a -9.83 paired gauntlet loss to DISCIPLE). Fixed with 50% history-block dropout in training; runtime feeds real history. After the fix: val aim top-1 83.3% / top-3 96.4% on hit rows (DISCIPLE: 56.8/82.8 on all rows), live aim error while firing 24.5° vs DISCIPLE's 42.8°, buttons fire 88.6% / reload 98.2%. Honest caveats: training-time bullet threats are RECONSTRUCTED from shot events (no spread, no pellet fan, no impact deletion) and exact only at runtime; FIRE_THRESH default 0.15 is base-rate calibrated (teacher fires ~12% of ticks). THE VERDICT (full paired gauntlet, EVAL_SPEC_V1): score -34.51; PRODIGY - DISCIPLE = -7.82 kills/match, 95% CI [-8.51, -7.12] (sign test +42/-307/=11) — the v2 senses did NOT beat the v1 student. Gap to the teacher: -47.03/match (quick, CI [-49.22, -44.78]). Post-mortem in the graph: better aim (24.5 deg vs 42.8 live) lost to worse trigger discipline — in-contact fire rate ~36% vs the teacher's disciplined taps maxes spray bloom (hit% 5.4 vs DISCIPLE 17.4), and the student cannot see its own spray heat (not in the replay rows). A negative result, cleanly measured. Like the disciple's card before it: a measurement of distillation, not a title claim.
